channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Jimmy likes hole-outs: Stanger with the eagle-2
item.description: Jimmy Stanger holed out from the fairway on the par-4 14th, his fifth hole in Round 2 of the 2026 Cognizant Classic. Watch the shot and the reax.

item.title: 'Adrian Peterson of crows': Bird jukes out Gerard
item.description: It appeared that Ryan Gerard hit a bird with a tee shot in Round 1 of the 2026 Cognizant Classic, but replay shows the bird made a nifty move to save its life. Gerard tells the tale on "Happy Hour with Smylie presented by Michelob Ultra."

item.title: Arnold Palmer Invitational field packs plenty of star power for third signature event
item.description: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy return rested for the Arnold Palmer Invitational after taking a week off following the Genesis Invitational. Here's who will be joining them at Bay Hill Club and Lodge in Orlando, Florida.

item.title: Fat Perez relives euro-step celebration at Players
item.description: Nick "Fat Perez" Stubbe stopped by Happy Hour with Smylie presented by Michelob Ultra during Round 2 play of the 2026 Cognizant Classic. FP admitted he's watch the highlight of himself euro-stepping after sinking a long putt on the 17th hole at the Players last year more than 100 times.

item.title: Cognizant Classic 2026: Adjusted Round 3 tee times, groupings, and how to watch
item.description: Round 3 of the 2026 Cognizant Classic will tee off earlier than expected due to weather in South Florida on Saturday. Here's when Golf Channel coverage starts and how to watch.

item.title: Austin Smotherman still leads Cognizant Classic, Brooks Koepka makes cut
item.description: Austin Smotherman stayed red-hot, with a 55-foot birdie putt on the par-3 17th among the highlights as he took a three-shot lead into the weekend.

item.title: Billy Horschel exchanges words with mouthy fan amid sloppy Cognizant finish
item.description: The incident took place Friday after Horschel played his second shot at the par-3 15th hole, the first of PGA National’s intimidating three-hole stretch.

item.title: Déjà vu for Stanger with second hole-out for eagle
item.description: Jimmy Stanger has had an afternoon of highs and lows at PGA National. This hole-out for eagle on the sixth hole was his second such shot of his second round at the Cognizant Classic. Those two moments have been offset by a pair of double bogeys though.

item.title: Smotherman carries 36-hole lead for first time
item.description: Austin Smotherman is leading by three strokes at the 2026 Cognizant Classic entering the weekend. Smotherman shot a 2-under 69 on Friday, a day after recording six straight birdies on his way to a tournament-best 62 in Round 1.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Cognizant Classic, Round 2
item.description: Extended highlights from the second round of the 2026 Cognizant Classic at PGA National, where there were several hole-outs and even some jawing with the fans.
